title: ESAU THE HATER, LIAR, AND KILLER

sense.text:
The Southern Poverty Law Center put Israel United in Christ at number three on its list of America’s largest hate groups, and the Ku Klux Klan at number twenty. Yet the woman who put us there, a high official of that same center, is accused of sending $1.2 million in donor money to an informant inside a white supremacist group, who was also her lover. The center paid Klan informants, one of them an imperial wizard who never showed a sign of reform and died a free man in 2023, from the same Klan that bombed the Birmingham church and killed four children. The Black Panthers, formed to protect our people from the Klan, were dismantled and some of their members are still in jail, while the Klan still exists. Have we ever lynched anyone or terrorized anybody? No. It is the scripture that is terrorizing them: to us it is a savour of life, and to them a savour of death.

But “we can do nothing against the truth, but for the truth.” There is nothing they can do against this truth but for the truth. No matter what light they paint us in, it is going to be for the growth of this truth. By putting us on that list they drew interest: people ask how a group can be number three and they never heard of it, and naturally they look into it. Some do not take anyone’s word at face value; they research and watch the videos to see what makes us a hate group. There is no such thing as bad publicity. They opened the door for a lot of people who never even heard of us to know that we exist.

And those who are meant to be in this truth will come, whether they heard of it in a positive light or a negative light. They watch the videos and say, they are actually speaking the truth, I need to join. The true people of the Lord are like Manchurian candidates: the moment we hear it, we know that is the way.

J. Edgar Hoover said the biggest threat to America is negro unity. That is why we are number three: they know who we are, and when we remember who we are and come back together as the Israelites, that is the end of their world. We are a threat not because we pick up guns. We have the number one weapon, and we do not need bullets: the Bible is our weapon. It is not just a book.

“Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies which the Lord shall send against thee, in hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in want of all things: and he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck, until he have destroyed thee.” How did Esau fully fulfil this? The chain did not come off until we were mentally destroyed, and what he used to destroy us mentally was Christianity. He gave us the Bible, but he gave it with Christianity, and that bent our minds to be submissive to white Jesus. The same book that is our weapon they used against us, because they gave us the slave Bible with books missing and indoctrinated us with their garbage, which is Christianity. If we did not accept it we were killed: whosoever would not worship the image of the beast was put to death. And we accepted it, and by accepting it the yoke could come off, because the mind was already broken.

It is like breaking an elephant for the circus: tie the two rear legs to a strong tree trunk and leave him there for weeks. He pulls and pulls and cannot move the tree. After that you remove the rope and he goes nowhere, because in his head the rope is still tied to the tree, and he does whatever you want. That is us today.

But as the Willie Lynch letter says, the mind has the ability to correct itself if it comes across a substantial historical truth. As we come back to the laws, statutes and commandments we realize it. Esau was so prideful that he did not burn the Bible; he waited until now to give us the NIV. So when we read it we see the Jews are black, Solomon is black, Jesus is black, and our eyes are opened.

If you doubt it is a weapon to conquer the world, look at slavery: they conquered the whole world with this book. Christianity got into China through musket guns and opium, and into India and the Arab lands the same way, not by talk about the Lord Jesus. When they dropped the atomic bomb, the world said, this is God, we like Jesus. In World War II the Salvation Army and the YMCA handed out pocket-sized copies of the Head of Christ painting to servicemen headed overseas: they were not just going to war, they were carrying a message.

Every Easter in Europe the Catholic church marches in white hoods in the name of Jesus. The Klan did not just decide one day to put a pointed hood over their heads: that is who they are, the same white people from Europe. What the Inquisition did in Europe the Klan continued here, killing, massacring and hunting black people. It is an old practice. These churches are teaching witchcraft. They are serving Satan, so they must kill the children of the Most High God as ritual sacrifices; that is why they kill us so much.

And behind them stands a statue. “What profiteth the graven image that the maker thereof hath graven it; the molten image, and a teacher of lies”. They practise idolatry: they have statues and bow down to them, and there is no profit in those things. They are a teacher of lies.

How can anyone in this day and age be a Catholic? It is the same church that enslaved you, the same church with statues all over the place, when you can read the Bible and see that this is not the way. In South America there are churches where the indigenous people may come in but must sit on the floor, not the chairs. Those churches did a number on us, until he destroyed us.

In Italy a Catholic church takes the skull of a dead person, puts it inside a statue, and the people clap, chant and kiss it. What Bible verse says to put a dead man’s skull inside a statue? The statue cannot speak and cannot walk, and nobody among thousands asked whose skull it was. They say only Haitians do voodoo, while in their own churches they do the same, and no black Catholic protests or leaves the church.

“For he is not a God of the dead, but of the living: for all live unto him.” He is not the God of the dead. So that church is the church of the dead, because it worships the dead.

Slave auctions regularly took place on the steps of churches and courthouses across the South, to show that slavery had divine approval and legal protection: the steps where people prayed on Sunday became markets for human flesh on Monday. They did not teach you that in history, because these people are damn liars. In Ghana the bishops went to Elmina Castle, where the church was above and the slave dungeon underneath.

“The wicked are estranged from the womb: they go astray as soon as they be born, speaking lies.” You might think there is hope for them. There is not. Can what the Bible says be undone? The Bible said we would go into slavery, and we did; it said we would forget who we are, and we did. So when it says they are wicked and go astray as soon as they are born, that is what it is.

“Speaking lies”: they lie about who they are. They say they are the Jews; they are not. They say they are the Christians; they are not. They are the devil the Bible speaks of. You are dealing with a lying ass nation that still cannot take accountability for all the murdering, plundering, thievery and killing it has done among our people. To this day the schools teach that Christopher Columbus discovered the world, with statues and holidays in his name, when at the end his own people put him in jail, that is how evil he was.

In 1916, 15,000 Texans watched the black teenager Jesse Washington burned alive in Waco after a trial of four minutes. Fifteen thousand people do not just wake up and go to a lynching; it was planned and spread. It is still happening today, only not before 15,000 people. They are insatiable for blood, and the blood they want is ours, because the whole earth was given to us and they hate that God has chosen us. So they kill us, lie about us and steal everything we have. You cannot reason with them: the scripture calls him the deaf adder that has no ears. The snake smiles and bobs his head, but he is looking for where to strike.

The churches were full stakeholders in slavery. Episcopal, Presbyterian, Baptist and Methodist churches owned enslaved people and kept them in pens beneath their sanctuaries while white Christians prayed upstairs; Georgetown’s Jesuit priests sold 272 people in 1838 to pay school debts; the Southern Baptists split from the Northern Baptists in 1845 to defend their right to keep slaves. They said the slave had no soul, and the church is to save souls, so the church was never for us. It was made to keep you docile and in further bondage. The whole church system is one of the biggest lies Esau ever perpetrated, and if you still believe in it you are a fool. Now that he has all the money in his pocket, everybody can be saved. If you so love Jesus, return what you stole, you damn thief.

In Michigan a group of white teenage girls invited a black girl with epilepsy over, got her drunk until she was unconscious, beat her, threatened to kill her and asked where they could hide the body, and filmed it all. They are young, to show you nothing has changed, and that is only what we can see. They film these things; this one just happened to get out, as the Most High makes their own mouth fall upon them.

“Behold, his soul which is lifted up is not upright in him.” There is no way your soul is right when you can take a sick child, get her drunk and beat the daylight out of her. When Rasheed Carter was found with his skull cut in half, they said an animal did it. What animal cuts a skull like a chainsaw? That is a bold-faced liar. We all know Esau is not right, and his hatred toward us is perpetual. He cannot change who he is.

There is audio of Nolan Wells’ friends saying, you killed him, he is already dead, and nobody is in jail and the investigation goes nowhere, because you are dealing with a murderous, hateful, thieving killer who happens to be in power. Men found hanging from trees are labelled suicides. You are not fighting one person: a bad cop is let go by the judge, the jury, the whole system. Your only way out is to dive deep into this book.

So stop taking the Sabbath classes for granted; the day will come when you wish you were at an IUIC school. Build your spirit now, while everything is nice. If you cannot make a good pass with no pressure on you, what happens when there is pressure in the game? There is a level of pressure we are not under yet. Brothers have been stabbed and shot at, but it will get worse, and if you are not building your faith now, how will you endure? This man controls everything and will not hand over the keys because we have a beautiful congregation; they are going to fight. Even John the Baptist, who baptized Christ and knew he was the Christ, sent from prison to ask, are you the one? Stop playing in the truth and build your faith.

How do you get faith? “So then faith cometh by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.” So ask yourself how often you are hearing the word of God. Do you watch videos? Do you read? Do you talk with brothers and sisters who go over scriptures with you, or about the nonsense you watched on TV the night before? Are we putting ourselves where the scripture becomes our life: the people we choose to talk with bringing out scriptures in our free time, listening to the audio Bible, reading, listening to classes?

And as you listen and read, write down what you do not understand. Many read and study and never have a question, as if they were the grand puba of the scriptures who understands everything the moment they open the Bible. That is a very bad place to be. Stop being full of yourself: keep a page called questions and write down everything you do not understand, so that when the time comes you have something to ask. That is how you grow.

Ephesians 6 is the whole armour: the helmet of salvation, the breastplate of righteousness, the sword of the spirit, the feet shod with the preparation of the gospel of peace. But “Above all, taking the shield of faith”. The movie 300 shows what a shield can actually do.

“Wherewith ye shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked.” The darts are arrows. In ancient war they wrapped cloth around arrows, dipped them in tar and set them on fire, and shot them at castles and at people. You are not just pricked: once that tar is on you it burns, and the fire consumes you after the arrow has killed you. Whoever shoots a fiery dart does not just want to kill you, he wants to eradicate you. So it is with Esau. When they come against IUIC they are not coming just to kill us; they want to erase us altogether, as though we never existed, and only the Lord’s mercy keeps us from being consumed.

On that day only your faith will hold you up. There is no such thing as fake it till you make it. And it is “darts”, with an s: there will be many trials, not one, each one aiming not only to kill you but to make it seem you never existed. So while the pressure is not yet what it will be, study hard, build your faith, and prepare yourself for your trials.

“Behold a flying roll”, twenty cubits long and ten cubits broad. The world calls them UFOs, unidentified flying objects, but we can identify them: they are IFOs, identified flying objects, the chariots of the Lord.

“This is the curse that goeth forth over the face of the whole earth”. Those chariots are friendly to us, but not to them. They come out of the moon like there is no tomorrow; they know they are here, but it is not time yet.

“For every one that stealeth shall be cut off as on this side according to it”. Are there a lot of thieves on this side of the world? We are not talking about Ray Ray and Pookie. There is a main character who is just a thief, who takes and takes and never has enough, and on this side of the earth he is going to be cut off.

“And every one that sweareth shall be cut off as on that side according to it.” What do they swear? That they are the Christians and that they are the Jews. They are neither. Between the seventh and tenth centuries the Khazars, a Turkic people between the Black Sea and the Caspian, had their king and elite convert to Judaism, not as a spiritual awakening but as a political mask. When Khazaria fell they migrated west into Ukraine, Poland and Germany and blended into the Jewish communities of Europe: the Ashkenazi, not descendants of Abraham. The empire never fell; they are the same people. They do not practise the law; they practise Kabbalah, and their Talmud tells you what they are into: pedophilia, bestiality, homosexuality, lesbianism. That is why most porn sites are owned by rabbis: you are supposed to be the head of a church, what the hell are you doing owning porn sites? They are perverted people, their soul is not right, and they could never be God’s people.

precepts.why:
What does the law say about the thief? “And he that stealeth a man, and selleth him, or if he be found in his hand, he shall surely be put to death.” We were stolen from our land, and we are still in our enemy’s land, still in the thief’s house, still his possession. He did not open his jailhouses and let us go.

Benjamin, in Jamaica, boasts against Judah about his own land and his own food, but he is a slave too: when America said you cannot bring any more doctors from Cuba, he said yes sir, boss. Forty percent of his food comes from America. We are oppressed together.

So when those chariots come back for us, where will they find us? In his hand. He is the thief, and the judgment for the thief is death.

And he is still stealing. Around half of Venezuela’s oil now goes to the United States; they kidnapped Maduro, locked him up for things he did not do, and took the oil. Let that open the eyes of those who still believe the US is not a country of thieves. In 1915 the Marines occupied Haiti for nineteen years. Haiti had its own money backed by gold, and they carted the gold out of the Haitian treasury to the City Bank of New York. Charlemagne Péralte led the Cacos against them and was betrayed by his own people. Jefferson refused to recognize Haiti’s independence, there was an embargo for sixty years, and France forced Haiti to pay an independence debt in 1825: the Eiffel Tower was built with Haitian money. Then the Monroe Doctrine: everything in my backyard is mine. They are the damn thieves the Bible speaks of.

“Woe unto him that buildeth his house by unrighteousness”. Was America built by unrighteousness? Slavery is unrighteousness, and so is robbing and pillaging countries. Woe means destruction to him that builds his house that way.

“And his chambers by wrong”. Was stealing all the gold out of Haiti wrong? Was making coups in every country of South America wrong? Every dictator who threw a coup in Latin America went to a military school in America, where the documents show they were taught to torture; they went back and overthrew presidents on behalf of America, and American companies came in behind them. In 1987 they changed Haiti’s constitution, which had not let foreigners own land, and now white people own land in Haiti. That is how they get rich. Haiti has the second largest reserve of uranium after South Africa; so why are we not rich? These countries are rich, Haiti and Africa alike, but somebody keeps building his house by wrong, stealing their wealth and carrying it home to live large.

They swear they are Christians; read Christianity’s death toll. From the Crusades and the Inquisitions to pogroms and forced conversions, Christianity has been a catalyst for some of the most violent events in history. Look up the words: a pogrom is a violent riot or attack directed against a specific ethnic or religious group, with a long history of targeting Jewish communities, from the Russian for to demolish violently. They tell the truth and hide the lie inside it behind a big word. Those Jewish communities were not the so-called white people in Israel; they were the true Jews, us. It was done deliberately against a specific people, and it will happen again. Christianity was made to destroy us.

The Bible tells us who did it. “Remember, O Lord, the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem; who said, Rase it, rase it, even to the foundation thereof.” When the Babylonians came to destroy us, Edom said destroy it to the foundation. They wanted everything eradicated. That is Esau, the damn devil, the thief.

So the Crusades, the Inquisition and the forced conversions were always against us, and slavery was a continuation of the crusade. That is why the Klan wears the same hood as the processions in Italy and Spain. In the old books the black people stand before knights and kings with swords behind their heads: accept Jesus or lose your head, and after a thousand heads the thousand and first says Jesus is king. That is where the conversos came from. Even then some secretly kept the law, so they set spies among us to see who was clean on the Sabbath. Then they baptized us into the kind of Christian they wanted, the kind that keeps no commandment. And the Christians are still killing today: the Klan practises Christianity. It is a murderous, evil church, and it never stops.

What they swear is blasphemy. “I know thy works, and tribulation, and poverty, (but thou art rich)”: we are rich because everything belongs to us. Not just the earth, the animals and the resources, but the people as well belong to us, even them, and they hate it.

“And I know the blasphemy of them which say they are Jews, and are not, but are the synagogue of Satan.” It is blasphemy for them to say they are Jews. They are Khazarians, from Ukraine, Poland, Czechoslovakia, Yugoslavia, Germany and Eastern Europe, who migrated to the land of Israel. They are the synagogue of Satan because they practise Kabbalah and have nothing to do with the law. They pretend to keep it, but their fringes are not made according to the law, and the side curls and the yarmulke are not biblical. They are not the people of the Lord.

How did they get the land? The same way the whites took America: through war. The first Jews who entered had Palestinian passports; the Palestinians let them in, as the natives here made treaties, and they took the whole house. They call it displacement, but it was killing, and their own people have admitted what they did in the first Nakba. They are thieves, haters and killers, and everything that comes out of their mouth is blasphemy.

sense.text:
“But unto the wicked God saith”: we have shown you who the wicked is. If you cannot see from the articles and videos that the white man is the wicked, the scriptures show it too, because the way they got their land is wickedness.

“What hast thou to do to declare my statutes”: as Christians and as Jews they declare the Lord’s statutes and claim to keep laws, and the Lord asks what they have to do with them. “Or that thou shouldest take my covenant in thy mouth?” One takes the old covenant, the other takes the new, and they remix it and say everybody can be saved.

“Seeing thou hatest instruction, and castest my words behind thee.” A white man with a Bible in his hand does not mean he loves God. He understands the power of the Bible and uses it to destroy us further. He created religions to divide us more. We were already divided into countries, Haitians against Dominicans, Jamaicans against Americans; then light skin against dark skin; then religion: Mormons against Baptists, non-denominational against Catholic, Adventist against Jehovah’s Witness. A plethora of division to choose from, so we stay divided.

Because the mind can correct itself when it comes across substantial truth, they made a duplicity of lies. Born Catholic, at twenty-five you see the Bible says no statues and you leave; at thirty you try Islam and find you are worshipping a rock; then you see the Lord said keep the Sabbath, but the Jewish people do not believe in Christ, so you join the Seventh-day Adventists for fifteen years before you see they are a lie too. If you never come across the truth, you might die. Lies inside lies, division inside division, like a spider’s web.

He casts God’s words behind him and wants nothing to do with them. He sold his birthright; he disobeyed his father and married into other nations. He never liked God’s words.

“When thou sawest a thief, then thou consentedst with him, and hast been partaker with adulterers.” When Africa was divided up, did America go against it? They are all in cahoots together. France, Portugal, Belgium, Spain each took their part. Ethiopia claims it was independent but was ruled by the Italians for years; Liberia was former slaves brought there, its flag a US flag with one star, and Firestone caused a massacre there. No part of Africa was not conquered. That is stealing, and they consent with one another.

“Thou givest thy mouth to evil, and thy tongue frameth deceit.” Are we not accused of every evil on this planet, black-on-black crime, the worst criminals? Their own data shows who the worst criminals are: they are. Their frame is deceit and lies. A black woman in DC lost her job because she revealed the numbers were being fabricated; they fired her, not the cops. When we are arrested all our records come out, while what they do they hide.

They speak evil against Christ. They say he is white when he is black. They speak against the doctrine of Christ: Christ came for the lost sheep of the house of Israel, and they say everybody can be saved. The law says one thing, and they say two men can marry, two women can marry, and we cannot even say what is a male and what is a female. And they speak evil against the people: they got us into an evil doctrine, and as long as we stay in their churches we are pawns in their scheme. All those denominations are teachers of lies. Go to their seminary, that cemetery school, and you come out speaking like the dead: the law done away, the Trinity, prayers to the Virgin Mary, statues.

Their Talmud speaks much evil against the black Messiah: it says he is punished in boiling excrement to this day. That is the tongue that frames deceit; that is the Antichrist. There are many antichrists: everyone who practises Christianity, and everyone in that synagogue, is an antichrist, because they do not know Jesus, and an antichrist will not make it into the kingdom. The Catholic church and the synagogue of Satan are pedophile churches; in Israel they cheered the soldiers who raped Palestinian prisoners and fired the woman who released the video, and a doctor who would not leave his hospital in Palestine was arrested and raped to death in their jail. That is a people whose book tells them it is okay to have sex with a child under nine years old.

“Thou sittest and speakest against thy brother; thou slanderest thine own mother’s son.” Are they not slandering us? They say we are not the Jews, that we are the worst criminals, ruffians and vagabonds, number three on the hate group list, when we never killed anybody. If we had, every newspaper would have a field day and we would not still be here. People among us have died whom we did not kill, and every year they bring it back up to paint us as killers.

precepts.why:
Unto the wicked. “The earth is given into the hand of the wicked”. Who is running the earth? Who has military bases all over the world, whose money must every nation do business with? The so-called white man, Esau. Who has the power to go into another country, take out its leader, bring him home and suffer nothing for it? Who says, I do not like your policies, we are going to kill you? They did it in Libya, and recently they did it in Haiti: the president refused the COVID vaccine and had just made a deal with Russian officials in Turkey, and two months later he was killed. Look at his rap sheet: a murderer, a killer, insatiable.

“He covereth the faces of the judges thereof”. Who are the judges? We are, and our faces are covered because we are not known. On the walls of the churches in Russia and Romania you still see the black images we left behind, but when they paint a new picture, they paint it white. Their movies and Google are always white. In the Bible the judges are black.

Who the wicked is, God says plainly. “The burden of the word of the Lord to Israel by Malachi. I have loved you, saith the Lord. Yet ye say, Wherein hast thou loved us? Was not Esau Jacob’s brother? saith the Lord: yet I loved Jacob, And I hated Esau”. God hated Esau, so Esau hates us right back.

“They shall build, but I will throw down”. The Most High has destroyed them before, and this time he is going to destroy them forever. “And they shall call them, The border of wickedness”. That is why the Arabs call him the great Satan: wherever this man goes, death, raping and pillaging follow. That is his character; he can never have enough. And all the while he claims to be Christian and claims to be the Jews.

Where does the wicked get his power? From Satan. We just saw how his church serves the Lord: a human skull inside a statue, kissed, with clapping and ceremony. They say only Haitians do voodoo, and in his churches he is doing voodoo. Voodoo is bad, whoever does it; shame on you if you still have candles under your bed. The point is the hypocrisy.

“And the devil, taking him up into an high mountain, shewed unto him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time. And the devil said unto him, All this power will I give thee, and the glory of them: for that is delivered unto me; and to whomsoever I will I give it.” The devil has power on this earth because the Lord delivered that power to him, and on this earth he gives it to whoever he wants.

And who said, I will take it? Who took the knee? Them cavemen, sitting in a cave with nothing but their dogs, which is why they love dogs so much: those were the only friends they had. They looked at us in fine castles and wanted that too, and the devil said, I can give it to you, all you have to do is take a knee. And they had nothing to lose: no clothes, nothing but their dogs and their roots. That is their nature, and by research they are very close to the Neanderthals; that gene is in them.

“And the beast which I saw was like unto a leopard, and his feet were as the feet of a bear, and his mouth as the mouth of a lion”: he has all the characteristics of the empires before him. “And the dragon gave him his power”. So Esau got his power from Satan.

At face value he speaks like a lamb, but he is really the dragon, so he has to put on that mask: we are God’s people, we have churches. No. His churches do not represent God at all, because his churches are oppressing God’s people, and to this day they do the same thing.

He has hated instruction from the beginning. “Cain brought of the fruit of the ground an offering unto the Lord. And Abel, he also brought of the firstlings of his flock and of the fat thereof. And the Lord had respect unto Abel and to his offering”, because that is what he ordained: he wanted animal sacrifice. “But unto Cain and to his offering he had not respect. And Cain was very wroth”. God gives you instruction, and you are mad at God?

“And the Lord said unto Cain, Why art thou wroth? and why is thy countenance fallen? If thou doest well, shalt thou not be accepted?” That is good instruction: you messed up, just do what I ask and everything will be fine. “And if thou doest not well, sin lieth at the door. And unto thee shall be his desire, and thou shalt rule over him.” If he does not do well, Satan is going to rule over him. God gave Cain a choice, as he gave us a choice between life and death. Did Cain choose life?

“Cain rose up against Abel his brother, and slew him.” Cain killed his brother instead of following God’s instruction. It is the same today: they hate us because they ain’t us, and they can never be us. No matter how hard they try to replace us, with a thousand churches and a thousand doctrines, they can never replace us, because the word is signed, sealed and delivered. We are the chosen people, the Israelites the Bible speaks of; the world belongs to us, and we are going to own this land.

He consents with the thief. “In the day that thou stoodest on the other side, in the day that the strangers carried away captive his forces, and foreigners entered into his gates”. And before it: “And thy mighty men, O Teman, shall be dismayed, to the end that every one of the mount of Esau may be cut off by slaughter.” The Most High is going to kill them. Why? “For thy violence against thy brother Jacob”. They hate us and have always been violent toward us; it is not just modern slavery, it goes back to the beginning. “And thou shalt be cut off for ever.”

“And cast lots upon Jerusalem, even thou wast as one of them.” They were in alliance with Babylon when we were destroyed. “Neither shouldest thou have rejoiced over the children of Judah in the day of their destruction”. While Israel was being destroyed they helped, and then “entered into the gate of my people in the day of their calamity”, and “laid hands on their substance”: they stole everything we had. That is their character.

“Neither shouldest thou have stood in the crossway, to cut off those of his that did escape”: they would not even let some of us escape. The Babylonians did not see us, and Esau pointed us out and cut us off. “Neither shouldest thou have delivered up those of his that did remain in the day of distress.” When another nation came against us, they were right there with them, partakers with thieves and killers: the enemy of my enemy is my friend. That is the pogrom again, a violent uprising that destroyed everything.

“Concerning Edom, thus saith the Lord of hosts; Is wisdom no more in Teman?” This is concerning Edom. “If grapegatherers come to thee, would they not leave some gleaning grapes?” Grape gatherers take the clusters and leave what falls on the ground or stays on the vine. “If thieves by night, they will destroy till they have enough.” An ordinary thief steals until his bags are full and then leaves.

“But I have made Esau bare”: Esau is different. To this day they are robbing Africa, and it never ends; they never have enough. Esau is like the ocean: all the rivers run into it and it is never full. If the apple tastes good, he wants the tree, and the land it stands on, because planted in his own country it will not taste the same. He takes everything. That is his character.

Read it again: “Remember, O Lord, the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem; who said, Rase it, rase it, even to the foundation thereof.” Even to the foundation. That shows their character was always, and always will be, to try to eradicate us, so that we do not exist at all.

Why does the colour of Christ matter? Because once you take that image, you do not have the real doctrine, and we let the Bible say it. “For if he that cometh preacheth another Jesus, whom we have not preached”. Somebody came and preached another Jesus, and taught a lie. The Bible did not teach this pale-skinned demon.

“Or if ye receive another spirit, which ye have not received”: by accepting this Christ you get Caesar’s spirit on you. Accept that image and you get the spirit of the man behind it: he killed his brother for power, slept with his sister, practised homosexuality, and they were known as the best poisoners in the world: straight killers. That is the spirit you put on when you accept the image, and that is why Christians are so violent. That is Christianity.

“Or another gospel, which ye have not accepted”: the moment you accept white Jesus, you get another gospel. Refuse that damn doctrine if you want to save your soul. You cannot enter the kingdom of God as a member of any sect of Christianity. Those are the cults, because they follow a doctrine they cannot prove from the Bible, and yet they want to say we are a cult.

sense.text: “I will bring it forth, saith the Lord of hosts, and it shall enter into the house of the thief”: the chariots are going to enter the house of the thief. “And into the house of him that sweareth falsely by my name”. Are they not swearing falsely by the Lord’s name? We have seen it: they stole the land, and they claim they are the Jews and the Christians.

precepts.why:
“Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Surely in the fire of my jealousy have I spoken against the residue of the heathen, and against all Idumea”. Who is Idumea? Esau; it is just the Greek form of Edom. “Which have appointed my land into their possession”: they appointed God’s land into their possession. Did they pay for it? They killed to get it.

And they took our name and gave us bywords and proverbs for names. You proud Jamaicans and proud Haitians, that is a byword. You should be proud to be an Israelite. That is why the truth cannot be spoken and the work of the Lord cannot be done in the churches: you cannot do the Lord’s work as a Catholic, a Baptist, a Presbyterian or an Episcopalian.

You must know that you are an Israelite, return to the laws, statutes and commandments, and rebuke those who have taken your place. You should be pissed off that somebody walks this earth pretending to be you and benefiting from your name, while you are called monkeys and coons.

sense.text:
“Thus saith the Lord; For three transgressions of Edom, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because he did pursue his brother with the sword, and did cast off all pity”. They have no pity on us whatsoever; they regard neither the old nor the young. “And his anger did tear perpetually”.

In Somalia in 1993 two Belgian paratroopers, sent supposedly to help, held a young Somali boy over an open fire. A child was force-fed salt water and made to eat his vomit; another was locked in a metal container in the heat for two days and found dead; a teenage girl was raped; a soldier urinated on a dead man. The soldiers did not deny it, said they were playing, and a Belgian military court acquitted them. Does that look like a game? That is perpetual hatred, from a people with no conscience, and it is the same people who will be coming for us. Just as in Israel, soldiers who rape are presented to the world as humanitarians.

So wake up. This is not a clubhouse, a social club or a hangout spot where we come to have a drink. This is life and death, and it is war, except that our weapon is not carnal: we are using the Bible. Understand who we are going up against.

precepts.why:
“Therefore the law is slacked”: if you think the justice system is going to give you justice, you are wrong. “And judgment doth never go forth”: there is never judgment for us. How many of us died here by lynchings and murders at the hands of white folks, and where was the judgment? Hold a boy over the fire, rape, and you do not go to jail, because the powers that be condone it: to them we are not human, we are cattle, and they can do whatever they want with us.

“For the wicked doth compass about the righteous; therefore wrong judgment proceedeth.” Look at the justice system and you can see who controls it: the wicked. The earth is given into the hand of the wicked, so we can never have righteous judgment.

The Civil Rights Act was passed only sixty-two years ago, and the people in power today are older than it. Nobody changed their minds when it passed: businesses shut their doors, pools and schools closed rather than integrate, and there were beatings, shootings and men found hanging from trees in modern times. The Christians say, it is 2026. Once you accept white Jesus you have a different spirit on you, and you are blind. Their attitude never changed, and it never could.

“But executing thy judgments upon them by little and little”: a little war here, a little flood there, tornadoes, hurricanes. The Most High is judging them little by little. “Thou gavest them place of repentance, not being ignorant that they were a naughty generation”: that is just who they are, their character.

“And that their malice was bred in them”: they were born with that hatred. “And that their cogitation would never be changed”: their way of thinking can never change. Even if they wanted to, they cannot. But the black Christians say, surely we can change Massa, he just needs the good Lord Jesus. You damn dummy.

“For it was a cursed seed from the beginning”: God knows who he made. “Neither didst thou for fear of any man give them pardon for those things wherein they sinned.” There is no forgiveness for Esau. He cannot change, and there is no pardon for him, so stop trying to save him.

“And Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing wherewith his father blessed him: and Esau said in his heart, The days of mourning for my father are at hand; then will I slay my brother Jacob.” That was his mind from way back then, and his cogitation can never change: it is his frame of mind today. That is why they are always going to kill us.

In North Miami in 2016 Charles Kinsey, a behavioural therapist, lay on the ground with his hands up, protecting an autistic patient, and did everything the officer said, and the officer shot him. When he asked why, the officer said, I don’t know. The malice is bred in him, and he does not even know why he does what he does. That is why you can have a white friend who is cool, as Nolan Wells’ friends were cool with him for years, and one day they transform into who they are. We hear a word behind us saying, this is the way, walk in it; they hear a voice behind them saying, kill him.

“Son of man, set thy face against mount Seir, and prophesy against it”: mount Seir is where Esau lived. “Behold, O mount Seir, I am against thee”: the Lord is not for them, he is against them. “And I will make thee most desolate. I will lay thy cities waste, and thou shalt be desolate”: the Lord is going to destroy them one day.

“Because thou hast had a perpetual hatred”: their hatred is perpetual, because their cogitation cannot be changed. “And hast shed the blood of the children of Israel by the force of the sword”: they shed our blood, and that is why he is called the bloody city; this land is drenched with our blood, by the weapons they used to kill us.

“In the time of their calamity, in the time that their iniquity had an end”. We disobeyed God’s laws and went into captivity. And even when our iniquity had an end, at emancipation, when they could have given us back our land, they said no: bring out the hoods, bring back the Inquisition, Jim Crow, the Black Codes. They never let us go.

“Therefore, as I live, saith the Lord God, I will prepare thee unto blood, and blood shall pursue thee: sith thou hast not hated blood, even blood shall pursue thee.” Since Esau does not hate blood, he is going to bathe in it; his blood will flow like a river. You think you can kill God’s people and nothing will happen to you? It is our job today to expose you, to let people know who you are.

sense.text: “Let no man deceive you by any means: for that day shall not come, except there come a falling away first”: the falling away was us going into captivity. “And that man of sin be revealed, the son of perdition”. That man of sin must be revealed, and it is our job to reveal him: that bloody man full of malice, hatred and lies, that thieving killer, because everybody took him as God.

“Who opposeth and exalteth himself above all that is called God, or that is worshipped; so that he as God sitteth in the temple of God, shewing himself that he is God.” That is his character. He made his image the image of God, the image of Christ, and the whole world worships him as God.

Even their own book, The Chosen People from the Caucasus, says it: nuclear war, environmental pollution and resource rape are all the result of Caucasoid behaviour, and the problem with the world is white men. That is what the Bible says too. The whole earth will rejoice when that man falls. The one they call Lucifer is not an angel: that is the white man.
